name: Dragon no Tiara
source:
The world where the civilized society collapsed with the appearance of the phantom beasts. You go on a journey on king's request to discover "Dragon's Tiara" item.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个幻兽出现、文明社会崩溃的世界。你受国王委托踏上旅程，寻找名为“龙之冠”的道具。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
